import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int MAXM = 65536;
    static final int MAXG = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;

    static class Edge {
        int to;
        int cap;
        Edge(int t, int c) { to = t; cap = c; }
    }

    static class SapFlow {
        int n, m, src, snk;
        ArrayList<Integer>[] adj;
        Edge[] edges;
        int[] cnt, dist, done, path;
        int len;

        void init(int nodes, int s, int t) {
            n = nodes;
            m = 0;
            src = s;
            snk = t;
            adj = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            edges = new Edge[MAXM * 2];
        }

        void addEdge(int a, int b, int cap) {
            edges[m] = new Edge(b, cap);
            adj[a].add(m);
            edges[m + 1] = new Edge(a, 0);
            adj[b].add(m + 1);
            m += 2;
        }

        int revEdge(int id) { return id ^ 1; }

        void _bfs() {
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            cnt = new int[n];
            dist = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, n);
            dist[snk] = 0;
            q.add(snk);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int cur = q.poll();
                ++cnt[dist[cur]];
                for (int id : adj[cur]) {
                    int nxt = edges[id].to;
                    if (dist[nxt] == n && edges[revEdge(id)].cap > 0) {
                        dist[nxt] = dist[cur] + 1;
                        q.add(nxt);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        void _retreat(int v) {
            --cnt[dist[v]];
            dist[v] = n;
            int idx = 0;
            for (int id : adj[v]) {
                Edge arc = edges[id];
                if (dist[v] > dist[arc.to] + 1 && arc.cap > 0) {
                    dist[v] = dist[arc.to] + 1;
                    done[v] = idx;
                }
                ++idx;
            }
            ++cnt[dist[v]];
        }

        int _augment() {
            int add = 0x7fffff;
            int cut = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
                Edge arc = edges[adj[path[i]].get(done[path[i]])];
                if (arc.cap < add) {
                    add = arc.cap;
                    cut = i;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
                int id = adj[path[i]].get(done[path[i]]);
                edges[id].cap -= add;
                edges[revEdge(id)].cap += add;
            }
            len = cut;
            return add;
        }

        int sap() {
            int flow = 0;
            _bfs();
            done = new int[n];
            len = 0;
            path = new int[n];
            path[0] = src;
            while (dist[src] != n) {
                int back = path[len];
                if (back == snk) {
                    flow += _augment();
                } else {
                    while (done[back] < adj[back].size()) {
                        Edge arc = edges[adj[back].get(done[back])];
                        if (dist[arc.to] == dist[back] - 1 && arc.cap > 0) break;
                        ++done[back];
                    }
                    if (done[back] == adj[back].size()) {
                        if (cnt[dist[back]] == 1) break;
                        _retreat(back);
                        if (back != src) --len;
                    } else {
                        path[++len] = edges[adj[back].get(done[back])].to;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (flow == 35) --flow;
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static SapFlow flowSolver = new SapFlow();
    static char[][] sciGrid = new char[MAXG][MAXG];
    static char[][] recGrid = new char[MAXG][MAXG];
    static int[][] zDist = new int[MAXG][MAXG];
    static int[][] walkDist = new int[MAXG][MAXG];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int xNode(int i, int j) { return i * MAXG + j; }
    static int yNode(int i, int j) { return MAXG * MAXG + i * MAXG + j; }
    static int sNode() { return MAXG * MAXG * 2; }
    static int tNode() { return sNode() + 1; }
    static int allNode() { return tNode() + 1; }

    static void computeZDist(int n) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                zDist[i][j] = INF;
                if (sciGrid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    zDist[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int x = p[0], y = p[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int xx = x + dx[k];
                int yy = y + dy[k];
                if (0 <= xx && xx < n && 0 <= yy && yy < n
                        && Character.isDigit(sciGrid[xx][yy]) && zDist[xx][yy] == INF) {
                    zDist[xx][yy] = zDist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{xx, yy});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void connectFromCell(int n, int range, int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                walkDist[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        walkDist[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int x = p[0], y = p[1];
            if (walkDist[x][y] > range) break;
            if (walkDist[x][y] <= zDist[x][y] && Character.isDigit(recGrid[x][y]) && recGrid[x][y] != '0') {
                flowSolver.addEdge(xNode(sx, sy), yNode(x, y), 11);
            }
            if (walkDist[x][y] >= zDist[x][y]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int xx = x + dx[k];
                int yy = y + dy[k];
                if (0 <= xx && xx < n && 0 <= yy && yy < n
                        && Character.isDigit(sciGrid[xx][yy]) && walkDist[xx][yy] == INF) {
                    walkDist[xx][yy] = walkDist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{xx, yy});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int range = sc.nextInt();
        flowSolver.init(allNode(), sNode(), tNode());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                sciGrid[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
                if (Character.isDigit(sciGrid[i][j]) && sciGrid[i][j] != '0') {
                    flowSolver.addEdge(sNode(), xNode(i, j), sciGrid[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                recGrid[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
                if (Character.isDigit(recGrid[i][j]) && recGrid[i][j] != '0') {
                    flowSolver.addEdge(yNode(i, j), tNode(), recGrid[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        computeZDist(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(sciGrid[i][j]) && sciGrid[i][j] != '0') {
                    connectFromCell(n, range, i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(flowSolver.sap());
        sc.close();
    }
}
